name: Duel School Infinite
source:
To the outside world, you’re at the top of the food chain—wielding a supernatural ability most people can only dream of!

At Takamagahara Academy… you’re small-fry.

Considered the weakest in the school, your only hope of survival is to keep your head down—but when a strange apparition appears in the hallways and it falls to you to uncover the truth, can you overcome your limitations to save yourself and the school?
translation:
在外界眼中，你站在食物链的顶端——身怀常人梦寐以求的超凡异能！

可在高天原学园…你不过是条微不足道的小杂鱼。

身为全校公认的最弱吊车尾，你唯一的生存之道便是夹起尾巴低调行事——然而，当诡异的幻影在教学楼走廊间现身、揭开真相的重任又偏偏落到你的肩上时，你能否突破自身极限，拯救自己与整座学园？
